methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional community-wide AI education infrastructure in Richmond, creating potential for distributed deep capability beyond elite tech workers if execution reaches broad populations.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional AI capability building in a traditionally non-tech region, but an academic lab focused on 'preparing leaders' suggests concentrated expertise rather than broad workforce distribution.

signals.title: Meta, Google invest in skilled worker training to build Virginia data centers - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Meta and Google investing in skilled worker training for data center operations concentrates workforce development around infrastructure hubs, creating narrow technical capability rather than broad AI fluency across the state.

signals.title: Column: AI can help dyslexic learners build career readiness - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: AI tools supporting dyslexic learners exemplifies shallow, platform-delivered AI adoption—using existing tools for accessibility rather than building indigenous AI capability or deep technical understanding in the region.

signals.title: Column: For rural Virginia, data centers are more than technology - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: Opinion piece positioning data centers as economic lifeline for rural Virginia reveals infrastructure without capability transfer—physical presence of AI infrastructure doesn't equal distributed AI skills or deep local engagement with the technology.
